basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (Tata Memorial Hospital), H.R.D. how_to_apply: Open the online application link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx.
Send your candidature through "Online Application" only.
Give complete information, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: TMC Research Project Manager at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the job location.

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre (Tata Memorial Hospital), H.R.D. Department

MK3475-593: A Prospective, Open-label, Phase 4 Study to Evaluate the safety of Pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA ®) in subject with Unsearchable or metastatic Melanoma or PD-L1 positive Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) in India (Keynote-593), Project (A/c no. 4386)
Initially for a period of six months

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Institute
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre, with its Tata Memorial Hospital, is a grant-in-aid institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is issued by its H.R.D. Department (HRD (Project), TMH). The post is for the Keynote-593 study, a prospective, open-label, Phase 4 study of Pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA ®) in unresectable or metastatic melanoma or PD-L1 positive non-small cell lung cancer in India, as the notice titles it.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 30 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date, no age relaxation and no desirable qualification. Internal candidates must submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. in Life Science / M. Pharm with PG Diploma in Clinical Research; OR M.Sc. in Clinical Research; OR Pharm. D.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Project Manager is paid Rs. 55,000/-p.m. The engagement is initially for a period of six months. The notice mentions no allowances or extension terms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Research Project Manager
content_sections.text: Open the online application link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx . Send your candidature through "Online Application" only. Give complete information, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Submit the application by 12.11.2026, up to 05:30 PM (Indian Standard Time). Use a valid email ID. All correspondence is by email only, and the interview date is sent by email to eligible candidates only. Receiving, downloading and printing related documents is the candidate's responsibility. For enquiries, the notice gives telephone 24177000, Ext No. 4664, and the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are first screened on the basis of the information in the online application form and then called for an interview. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right not to call any candidate for interview without assigning any reason. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice; the date will be sent by email to eligible candidates. Candidates called for interview must carry original documents supporting the date of birth, qualifications, experience and other details given in the online form. Those who do not will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The notice lists these committee members: Dr. C. S. Pramesh, Director, TMH; Dr. Sushmita Rath, Prof. Medical Oncology 'F' (Solid Tumor); Dr. Anuradha Mehta, Asst Prof. E (Medical Onco) (Solid Tumor); Mr. C.T. Shetty, Administrative Officer, HRD, TMH; and Worker Union Office.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If the candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria, or has given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed any material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. Tata Memorial Centre takes no responsibility for non-receipt of an application online. Tata Memorial Centre is not responsible for any loss of email caused by an invalid or wrong email ID, or by delivery to the spam/bulk mail folder.
